content: We need to extract SMILES of unknown sample. We have many tools: mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. We need to determine structure. Likely we need to run experiments to get data, then infer SMILES. We must be efficient, minimize expensive measurements. Perhaps we can start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then use DBE, etc. Use get_formula_from_smiles? Not yet. We need to get formula from unknown; we don't have SMILES. So we need to get mass spec first. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
